importExport.untitledFolder: Name given to an imported folder that has none. Saved as data.
importExport.untitledEnvironment: Name given to an imported environment that has none. Saved as data.
importExport.gostmanExport: Name of the file format when reported in messages, for example This Gostman export contains no requests.
importExport.undetected: Postman, OpenAPI, Swagger and Gostman are product and format names and stay.
importExport.noRequests: Shown when a Gostman export file was read but holds nothing to import.
importExport.unreadable: Shown when a Gostman export file could not be read.
importExport.invalidYaml: {{reason}} is the technical reason from the parser.
importExport.missingGostman: gostman is the name of a key in the file and stays as written.
importExport.namesMore: {{names}} is a list of names and {{count}} the number of further names.
importExport.tlsKept: {{names}} is a list of request names in quotes. TLS verification stays on; the user can turn it off per request.
